en.title: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
en.abstract: Two collective coordinates place every layer of a language model on one phase diagram. Trained models settle in a central working phase, while most untrained networks drift toward collapse or noise; training pulls the inference flow into the working phase, which we interpret as a phase transition.
en.alt: Schematic phase diagram: a trained inference flow settles in the central working phase, while untrained flows drift toward noise and collapse

zh.title: 语言模型训练与推理的相图
zh.abstract: 两个集体坐标把语言模型的每一层画到同一张相图上。训练后的模型停在中央的工作相，未训练的网络大多漂向坍缩或噪声；训练把推理流拉进工作相，我们把它解释为一次相变。
zh.alt: 相图示意：训练后的推理流停在中央的工作相，未训练的推理流漂向噪声区和坍缩区
